name: NautiK9 Lemonade Stand
description: One page that adds more engines to the Lemonade you already run: press Set up and it installs the engine, starts it, adds it to Lemonade and asks a test question. Ternary BitNet, Ternary Bonsai 8B (CPU or Vulkan GPU) and Iced Lemon Cake today, with an adapter maker for new engines.
